purpose: Cohort-access feasibility and variable-design supplement for future Iowa cancer models

resources.name: Agricultural Health Study individual-level cohort
resources.access: Controlled collaborative access: contact AHS investigator, register STaRS, submit proposal/variable checklist for Executive Committee review, execute confidentiality agreement. No application submitted.
resources.record_grain: Participant; questionnaire wave; cancer/other outcome episode; ancillary sample where applicable
resources.population: Iowa/North Carolina applicators and spouses; main AHS site enrollment N=89655 (52394 private applicators; 32345 spouses; 4916 Iowa commercial applicators); descriptive NIEHS counts differ slightly
resources.time_coverage: Enrollment 1993-1997; active phases 1999-2003, 2005-2010, 2013-2015, 2019-2021; exact restricted analytic data freeze not verified
exposure_variables: Pesticide-specific reported histories and application practices
Selected ancillary biomarkers/environmental linkages; field-level availability must be confirmed
outcome_variables: Renal and Medicare linkages with distinct eligibility
resources.join_restrictions: No unrestricted identifiers or external linkage right established; use only approved variables/purpose; enrichment and derived-data sharing require study-approved terms
resources.limitations: Two-state selected cohort; role/wave eligibility and response differ; exposure histories not continuous dose; public summaries not an analytic release

resources.name: AHS public cancer summaries and blank coded enrollment instrument
resources.access: Public aggregate tables and blank questionnaire PDF; no individual data
resources.record_grain: Cancer site x applicator/spouse group x overlapping phase/sample completion count; All summary retained
resources.time_coverage: Cancer tables complete through registry year 2021 for both IA and NC; retrieved 2026-10-22; questionnaire is historical enrollment instrument with OMB expiration 1996-08-31
resources.units: Aggregate counts; not rates, person-years or Iowa-only counts
resources.join_restrictions: No person keys exist; cannot link to participant data from this public table
resources.limitations: 46 rows include 2 All summaries; subset columns overlap; previous different-site cancers included; current restricted release cutoff unknown; do not sum All and sites

resources.name: Iowa Women's Health Study full cohort
resources.publisher: University of Minnesota; NCI Cohort Consortium listing
resources.access: Official study/custodian description and CEDCD id=22 verified. Current full-cohort download, formal request policy and shareable fields not independently verified; institutional inquiry required.
resources.record_grain: Woman x questionnaire wave/outcome; exact released schema unavailable
resources.population: Iowa women age 55-69 in 1986; university reports 41837; some original methods 41836; analysis exclusions vary
resources.time_coverage: Baseline 1986; surveys 1987/1989/1992/1997/2004; published Medicare linkage 1986-2004 and kidney analysis 1986-2011 are analysis-specific, not verified final release cutoff
exposure_variables: Specialized environmental histories/linkages described in publications; current shareability unverified
outcome_variables: Selected Medicare-linked conditions in approved analyses
resources.join_restrictions: Unverified current terms. Published protected-identifier Medicare linkage does not authorize outside linkage or access to identifiers.
resources.limitations: Older female cohort; not Iowa-wide all-age/sex sample; current dictionary, consent, release cutoff and external access terms unresolved; CEDCD description did not render useful access details

resources.name: dbGaP CIDR colorectal-cancer case set including an IWHS subset
resources.access: Verified Authorized Access/Data Use Certification route for phs001905.v2.p2; no request or data download
resources.record_grain: Selected colorectal-cancer case and tumor/matched-normal sequencing sample; multi-study
resources.population: 4341 consented subjects across source studies; 4518 tumor/matched-normal DNA samples described; IWHS-specific count not verified
resources.time_coverage: Current indexed version v2.p2 verified; exact diagnosis years and IWHS-specific ascertainment not verified
resources.join_restrictions: Access is consent/DAC/DUC controlled; no unrestricted linkage permission; full-cohort IWHS access cannot be inferred
resources.limitations: Not full IWHS; not a cohort incidence denominator; selected consent and sample availability; exclusions documented by accession; selected-subset overlap with other studies needs tracking

resources.name: Historical Iowa/Minnesota NHL/leukemia case-control studies and NCI pooled NHL resource
resources.access: NCI pooled-resource page names investigator inquiry route. DCEG collaboration/data request and Data Transfer Agreement policy verified; exact original-file availability/dictionary and approval not verified. No public person-file download located.
resources.record_grain: Case/control person plus recalled exposures; pooled-study membership; shared controls
resources.population: Original NHL 622 white male cases/1245 controls; associated leukemia 578 cases/1245 controls. NCI four-state pool describes about 1000 NHL cases/3000 controls; not independent additional people.
resources.time_coverage: NHL diagnosis eligibility: Iowa March 1981-October 1983; Minnesota October 1980-September 1982; histories precede diagnosis; original papers 1990/1992/1993
outcome_variables: Leukemia in associated study; exact available subtype schema needs confirmation
resources.join_restrictions: DCEG DTA requires no reidentification or linkage to individually identifiable external records; release and use must be approved; do not infer geographic/person keys available
resources.limitations: Recall/proxy interview and historical coding; matching/case-control sampling; shared-control and pooled-participant overlap; cannot infer population rates; no current exposure representativeness

resources.name: Mayo IA/MN/WI lymphoma case-control study and later biobank work
resources.access: Public protocol description and blank questionnaire links verified; general external participant-data access terms/download not verified
resources.record_grain: Clinic-based lymphoma case/control person; biospecimen; later biobank cohort is separate design
resources.population: IA/MN/WI Mayo Rochester patients; controls attending prescheduled general examinations, frequency matched by age/sex/residence
resources.time_coverage: Original case-control enrollment September 2002-August 2014; later post-August-2014 biobank work described separately
resources.join_restrictions: Current external terms unverified; no permission inferred from public forms or InterLymph participation
resources.limitations: Not the 1980s IA/MN population-based study or full Iowa registry; clinic controls; exact available counts/releases/fields unresolved
